about: Joey64 per-game database: what each game needs, what is wrong with it and where, and what was fixed. Seed for the M3 profile DB. Rules: gamedb/README.md. Update this file in the same commit as any change to a game's status (new problem found, fixed, regressed, setting added or dropped).

games.title: Pokemon Snap

settings.what: synchronous parallel-RDP (smart sync), also in fast-forward
settings.why: photo checks read the framebuffer; async can hand the CPU a stale one

issues.what: Oak's Mark photo check not yet checked under smart sync (Snap moved from plain sync to smart sync)
issues.evidence: README Pokemon Snap photo check item

issues.what: Oak's Mark fix (upstream PRs gonetz/GLideN64#2991, libretro #674) not rechecked after the gonetz update, core d8f51f5

notes: VI filters off: +20% speed on the Flip, the biggest gain of the 14 bench games (2026-11-05, vifilt)

settings.why: async: halts on a 'secret cheat, power off' screen after ~10 s

fixed.what: ran at 121 fps on 120 Hz screens (audio did not pace it)
fixed.fix: speed cap when audio does not pace, app 0985fb0

issues.what: rooms in gameplay (pre-rendered backgrounds + 3D) only checked up to the intro video and save screen; check in-game from a save, also on the Flip
async with texture load snapshots (N64_RDP_TEX_SNAPSHOT=1): plays on the Duo, still black on the Flip, so it stays synchronous
bench state stops on the Controller Pak notice, so its bench numbers are a static menu (150-1190 fps swings); needs a state in a race

fixed.what: RSP looped on the boot screen with precise smart sync
fixed.fix: copies (DMA, RSP, C code) always wait, core 2938164

settings.what: synchronous parallel-RDP on every GPU, also in fast-forward
settings.where: kSyncRdpGames (was kAdrenoSyncGames, Adreno fast-forward only, until 2026-11-05)
settings.why: async: intro draws, then black (Odin 3 and Duo 2026-11-03, every Flip run since 2026-11-05)

settings.what: save type 16K EEPROM for hacks (header ID)
settings.why: hacks not in the database got 4K and could not save

settings.what: smoother timing, CountPerOp=1 (counter factor 1), on Adreno 730 and up (Portal, Odin 3, Thor) only
settings.why: Odin 3 28.6 -> 30.0 fps; compat with it passed on the Odin 3 and Portal (odin3-/portal-smoothc), Joey 2026-11-06. Hacks with this ID get it too

fixed.what: draws its intro, then every frame black from ~25 s with async parallel-RDP (repeat skip off: still black, so not the skip; sync: plays)

games.title: Perfect Dark

fixed.what: judder at 60 fps: audio every other frame (0, then 1474 samples) made audio sync start frames 5 then 28 ms apart, ~240 of 300 frames uneven per 5 s
fixed.fix: smoothed audio wait, automatic above 60 Hz, app 6de8bb8. Duo: uneven 244 -> 39, lag 20.2 -> 18.6 ms; Odin 3: 246 -> 28, lag 18.3 -> 15.7 ms; 0 underruns; same-build underrun A/B clean (chain72)

fixed.what: Portal: menu background shifted down (async build of 2026-11-03)

notes: input delay steady 18-24 ms (Smash 16-18); an earlier 54-83 ms was an averaging artifact
Flip slow frames are a first-run dynarec compile burst (2009 blocks / 273 ms in one window), like MK64
100-140 ms boot frames on the Flip

games.title: Ocarina of Time
notes: reads its depth buffer every frame (lens flare): smart sync waits 599 of 600 frames; lazy waking of the RDP worker costs it 3% on the Portal (Snap 15%, GoldenEye 6%: games where the CPU waits on GPU results)
hacks Sands of Time, Sealed Palace, Master of Time, Missing Link, Dawn & Dusk share the CZL ID: tell them apart by crc
